name: Keyboard shortcut
description: Key caps joined by + (e.g. Ctrl + Shift + P) with an optional caption saying what the shortcut does.

params.name: keys
params.help: Up to 5 keys in order, e.g. ["Ctrl", "Shift", "P"]; symbols like ⌘ or ⇧ work too

params.name: caption
params.help: What it does, e.g. Open the command palette (empty: none)
